title: A cup of coffee / over / under ...
subtitle: 一杯咖啡 / 在……上方 / 在……下方……

lead.question: 朋友问你「要来杯咖啡吗？加糖加奶吗？」——你会用 like / want 表达喜好，并用 one 代替「一块饼干」吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象茶歇场景：你问客人「喜欢咖啡吗？要一杯吗？要加糖/牛奶吗？」客人说「我喜欢清咖啡，不要奶」。这里有两个关键：① 一般现在时陈述喜好 I like ... / I don't like ...；② 当对方问 Do you want one? 时，one 是代词，代替前面提过的单数可数名词（a biscuit）。先试着用 like/want 点一杯咖啡，再听 Mrs. Young 和 Mrs. Price 的对话。第 48 课则把 over/under/across 等方位介词铺开。
goals: 能用 Do you like ...? / I like ... / I don't like ... 表达喜好（一般现在时）
能用 Do you want ...? / Yes, please. / No, thank you. 礼貌请求
理解代词 one / ones 代替单数/复数可数名词
掌握方位介词 over / under / across / along / off / between / in front of / behind
lead.summary: 第 47 课 Mrs. Young 问 Mrs. Price 要不要咖啡、加不加糖奶；Mrs. Price 要糖不要奶，要一块饼干（Do you want one?）。全课用一般现在时表喜好，并引出代词 one。第 48 课 A 组用 over/under/across/along/off/between/in front of/behind 描述物体方位，B 组用 I like ... but I don't want one/any 巩固 one/ones 与 some/any。
lead.tips: ① like/want 用一般现在时表喜好与意愿；否定 I don't like ... / I don't want ...；② Do you like ...? 简略回答 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.（do 问 do 答）；③ one 代替单数可数名词（a biscuit → one），ones 代替复数；any 用于不可数/否定；④ black coffee 清咖啡（不加奶），white coffee 加奶咖啡；⑤ 方位介词 over（在……正上方，不接触）/ under（在……正下方）/ across（横过）/ along（沿着）/ off（离开）/ between（在……之间）。

questions.q: How does Ann like her coffee?
questions.a: She likes black coffee — she doesn't like milk in her coffee.
questions.aZh: 她喜欢清咖啡，咖啡里不放奶。
questions.hint: 听 No, thank you. I don't like milk in my coffee. I like black coffee.

questions.q: Does Mrs Price want milk in her coffee?
questions.zh: 普赖斯太太的咖啡里要放牛奶吗？
questions.a: No, she doesn't. She likes black coffee.
questions.hint: No, thank you. I don't like milk in my coffee.

questions.q: What does Mrs Young offer Mrs Price besides coffee?
questions.zh: 除了咖啡，扬太太还给了普赖斯太太什么？
questions.hint: Do you want any sugar? / Do you like biscuits? Do you want one?

questions.q: What does 'Do you want one?' refer to?
questions.zh: 「Do you want one?」里的 one 指什么？
questions.hint: 前文 Do you like biscuits? 的 biscuit。

questions.q: Why do we say 'Do you want one?' instead of repeating 'a biscuit'?
questions.zh: 为什么用 Do you want one? 而不重复 a biscuit？
questions.a: one is a pronoun that replaces a singular countable noun already mentioned (a biscuit), avoiding repetition. For plural we'd use ones; for uncountable we'd use any/some.
questions.aZh: one 是代词，代替刚提过的单数可数名词（a biscuit），避免重复；复数用 ones，不可数用 any/some。
questions.hint: one 代替单数可数名词。

questions.q: The aeroplane is flying over the village. / The ship is going under the bridge. / The children are swimming across the river.
questions.zh: 第 48 课 A 组操练：用 over/under/across/along/off/between/in front of/behind 描述方位。
questions.a: Two cats are running along the wall. / The girl is sitting between her mother and her father.
questions.aZh: 两只猫沿着墙跑。/ 女孩坐在父母之间。
questions.hint: over 上方不接触，under 正下方，across 横过。

grammar.title: 代词 one / ones 代替可数名词
grammar.structure: one（单数可数）/ ones（复数可数）代替前文提过的名词
grammar.definition: one 是代词，代替刚提过的单数可数名词，避免重复（a biscuit → one）；ones 代替复数。不可数名词不用 one，而用 some/any。
grammar.usage: Do you want one? (= a biscuit) / I like those red apples, but I don't want the green ones.

examples.en: Do you want one?
I like biscuits, but I don't want one.
examples.zh: 我喜欢饼干，但我不想吃一块。

grammar.title: 方位介词 over / under / across / along / off / between / in front of / behind
grammar.definition: over 在……正上方（不接触）；under 在……正下方；across 横过；along 沿着；off 离开/脱离；between 在两者之间；in front of 在……前面（外部）；behind 在……后面。
grammar.usage: 描述物体方位：The aeroplane is flying over the village.

examples.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
The girl is sitting between her mother and her father.

grammar.title: 一般现在时表喜好（like / want）
grammar.structure: 主语 + like(s) / want(s) + 名词（/ 不定式）
grammar.definition: 一般现在时可陈述现在的状态、习惯与喜好。like/want 表喜好与意愿，否定借助 do/does not，疑问用 Do/Does ... like/want ...?，简略回答 do 问 do 答。
grammar.usage: I like black coffee. / I don't want any milk in my tea.
